name: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Minorities
description: A scholarship scheme to encourage parents from minority communities to send their school-going children to school, lighten their financial burden, and sustain their efforts to support their children's education.
educationLevel: Classes 1 to 10 (Subject to current policy revisions limiting to Class 9-10)
eligibility: Must belong to a notified minority community (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi)
Must be studying in India in a government or recognized private school
Must have secured not less than 50% marks in the previous final examination
incomeCriteria: Annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹1,00,000.
benefits: Admission and tuition fee coverage
Maintenance allowance per month (varying for Day Scholar and Hosteller)
documents: Income Certificate issued by competent authority
Bank Account details linked with Aadhaar
Fee receipt of current course year

procedure: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Fill out the application form under 'Pre-Matric Scholarship Schemes for Minorities'
Upload necessary documents (if scholarship amount is > ₹50,000, otherwise keep in school)
Submit for Institute level and State level verification

verification.notes: Verified against NSP guidelines for Ministry of Minority Affairs.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Minorities
description: Scholarship awarded to students of minority communities to pursue higher education from Class 11 up to Ph.D. level in government/recognized private institutions.
eligibility: Must belong to a notified minority community (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi)
Must have secured not less than 50% marks or equivalent grade in the previous final examination
incomeCriteria: Annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,00,000.
benefits: Admission and tuition fee coverage (subject to actuals or maximum ceiling)
Maintenance allowance per month (varying for Day Scholar and Hosteller)
documents: Bank Account details linked with Aadhaar
Fee receipt of current course year

procedure: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Complete the application under 'Post-Matric Scholarship Schemes for Minorities'
Upload required documents
Submit the application for institutional verification

name: Merit-Cum-Means Scholarship for Professional and Technical Courses CS (Minorities)
description: A scholarship to provide financial assistance to poor and meritorious students belonging to minority communities to enable them to pursue professional and technical courses.
eligibility: Must belong to a notified minority community
Must have secured not less than 50% marks in the previous final examination
Must be pursuing a technical or professional course at UG/PG level from a recognized institution
incomeCriteria: Annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,50,000.
benefits: Full course fee reimbursement for listed premium institutions
Course fee up to ₹20,000 per annum for other institutions
Maintenance allowance of ₹1,000 per month (hosteller) or ₹500 per month (day scholar)
documents: Bank Account details linked with Aadhaar

procedure: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Select the Merit-cum-Means scheme
Upload required documents (Income, Community, Marksheets)
Submit for verification

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students
description: A centrally sponsored scheme to support parents of SC children for education of their wards studying in classes IX and X.
eligibility: Student must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC)
Must be studying in class 9 or 10 in a government school or recognized private school
incomeCriteria: Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000.
benefits: Academic allowance for 10 months
Adhoc grant per annum
Additional allowances for students with disabilities

procedure: Apply via the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) or respective State Scholarship Portals (e.g., UP Scholarship, MahaDBT) depending on the state's integration
Upload caste and income certificates
Submit for school and district welfare officer verification

name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC Students
description: Centrally sponsored scheme providing financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education.
educationLevel: Class 11, 12, UG, PG, Technical, Vocational courses
eligibility: Must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC)
Must be studying a recognized post-matriculation course in India
Must not be holding another government scholarship
incomeCriteria: Annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,50,000.
benefits: Maintenance allowance per month (varies by course group)
Reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees
Study tour charges, thesis typing/printing charges
Book allowance for students pursuing correspondence courses

procedure: Apply via National Scholarship Portal (NSP) or State Portal depending on the state of domicile
Submit the application with valid caste and income certificates
Institute and State Nodal Officer verify the application before DBT transfer

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
description: Financial assistance to ST students studying in classes IX and X to reduce dropout rates and support secondary education.
eligibility: Must belong to Scheduled Tribe (ST)
Must be studying in Class 9 or 10 on a full-time basis
incomeCriteria: Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,00,000 (often aligned with state rules, standard limit ₹2 Lakh/₹2.5 Lakh).
benefits: Monthly maintenance allowance
Annual ad-hoc grant

procedure: Application is usually submitted through the National Scholarship Portal or respective State Government Portals
Verification is done at the school level and district level

name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for ST Students
description: Financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe students for pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary courses.
eligibility: Must belong to Scheduled Tribe (ST)
Must be pursuing recognized post-matriculation courses
incomeCriteria: Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000.
benefits: Maintenance allowance
Reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees
Book allowance
Additional allowances for ST students with disabilities

procedure: Register and apply via the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) or State specific portals
Upload mandatory certificates
Institute verification followed by State approval for DBT

name: National Means Cum Merit Scholarship (NMMS)
description: A centrally sponsored scheme to award scholarships to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest their drop out at class VIII and encourage them to continue study at secondary stage.
authority: Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education
eligibility: Must have passed Class 8 with minimum 55% marks (50% for SC/ST)
Must have cleared the State Level Selection Test for NMMS
Must be studying as regular students in Government, Government-aided, and local body schools
incomeCriteria: Annual family income must not exceed ₹3,50,000.
benefits: Scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) for classes IX to XII

procedure: Clear the State Level NMMS examination conducted by SCERT/State Education Boards
Qualified students register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Apply under the 'Department of School Education & Literacy' scheme
School verifies the application and forwards to District Nodal Officer

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students
description: Financial assistance provided to meritorious students from low-income families to meet day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies.
authority: Department of Higher Education (DoHE), Ministry of Education
eligibility: Must be above 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream in Class 12 of respective State Examination Boards
Must be pursuing regular UG/PG courses in colleges/institutions recognized by AICTE/UGC/MCI/DCI, etc.
Not availing any other scholarship
incomeCriteria: Annual family income must not exceed ₹4,50,000.
categoryCriteria: General, SC, ST, OBC (Based on State Board Quotas)
benefits: ₹12,000 per annum at Graduation level for first three years
₹20,000 per annum at Post-Graduation level (and 4th/5th year of professional courses)

procedure: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Select the 'Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students'
Fill the application and authenticate Aadhaar
Submit for verification by the Institution and the State Board

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Technical Degree/Diploma)
description: A scheme by AICTE aimed at providing assistance for the advancement of girls pursuing technical education. It empowers young women to further their education and prepare for a successful future.
authority: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
eligibility: Girl students admitted to First year of AICTE approved Degree/Diploma course OR Second year (Lateral Entry)
Maximum two girl children per family are eligible
incomeCriteria: Family income from all sources must not exceed ₹8,00,000 per annum.
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study (maximum 4 years for Degree and 3 years for Diploma) as a lump sum amount towards college fee, computer purchase, stationeries, books, etc.
documents: Admission Letter to AICTE approved institution

procedure: Apply via the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Select the AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Degree or Diploma depending on the course
Upload required documents and submit for Institutional and AICTE nodal officer verification

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially Abled Students
description: A scholarship scheme by AICTE to provide financial support to specially-abled students pursuing technical education.
authority: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
educationLevel: Undergraduate Degree / Diploma in Technical Courses
eligibility: Specially-abled students having disability of not less than 40%
Admitted to First year of AICTE approved Degree/Diploma course OR Second year (Lateral Entry)
incomeCriteria: Family income from all sources must not exceed ₹8,00,000 per annum.
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study as a lump sum amount for expenses related to college fee, books, software, special equipment, etc.
documents: Disability Certificate (minimum 40%) issued by competent medical authority

procedure: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Select AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme
Upload the Disability Certificate along with other academic and income documents
Submit for verification

name: AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme
description: Scholarship to provide financial support to orphans, wards of parents who died due to COVID-19, and wards of Armed Forces and Central Paramilitary Forces martyred in action.
authority: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
educationLevel: Undergraduate Degree / Diploma in Technical Courses
eligibility: Must be an Orphan OR
Must be a ward whose either or both parents died due to Covid-19 OR
Must be a ward of Armed Forces and Central Paramilitary Forces martyred in action
Admitted to AICTE approved institutions and courses
incomeCriteria: Family income from all sources must not exceed ₹8,00,000 per annum.
benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study as a lump sum amount towards college fee, books, and living expenses
documents: Death Certificate of Parents (for COVID victims/Orphans) or Martyr Certificate from Armed Forces

procedure: Apply via the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Select the AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme
Upload specific proof certificates (Death certificates/Martyr documents)
Submit for Institutional and AICTE verification

name: PG Indira Gandhi Scholarship for Single Girl Child
description: A UGC scholarship to support postgraduate education of single girl children and compensate for direct costs of girl education at all levels.
eligibility: Must be admitted to regular, full-time 1st-year Master's Degree course in any designated university/college
Girl student must be the only child of her parents (no brother or sister)
Age Limit: Maximum 30 years at the time of admission to PG course
incomeCriteria: No specific income limit is applied.
benefits: ₹36,200 per annum for a period of two years (the duration of the PG course)
documents: Affidavit on ₹50 Stamp paper declaring single girl child status

procedure: Apply online on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) during the application window
Upload the original sworn affidavit confirming single child status
Submit for verification by the University/College Nodal Officer

verification.notes: Verified against UGC PG Single Girl Child scheme guidelines.

name: PG Scholarship for University Rank Holders
description: Scholarship designed to attract talent for pursuing post-graduate studies by offering financial assistance to 1st and 2nd rank holders at the undergraduate level.
eligibility: Must be the 1st or 2nd Rank holder at the UG level in designated university/institution
Must have obtained a minimum of 60% marks at the undergraduate level
Must be admitted to a regular, full-time Master's degree course
Maximum age limit is 30 years at the time of admission to the PG course
incomeCriteria: No specific income limit.
benefits: ₹3,100 per month for a period of two years (10 months per year)
documents: Rank Certificate issued by the University stating 1st or 2nd rank and total number of students

procedure: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Select the UGC PG Rank Holders scheme
Upload the official Rank Certificate from the University
Submit for institutional verification

verification.notes: Verified against UGC PG Rank Holder guidelines.

name: Ishan Uday Special Scholarship Scheme for NER
description: A special scholarship scheme by UGC to promote higher education, increase Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER), and encourage professional education among students of the North Eastern Region (NER).
state: North Eastern States (Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura)
eligibility: Students must be domiciles of the North Eastern Region (NER)
Must have passed Class 12 or equivalent from a school situated in NER
Must have secured admission in the first year of any general degree, technical, or professional course in a recognized institution
incomeCriteria: Annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹4,50,000.
benefits: ₹5,400 per month for General Degree courses
₹7,800 per month for Technical/Medical/Professional/Paramedical courses
Paid for the entire duration of the course
documents: Domicile Certificate of a North Eastern State

procedure: Apply via the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Select the 'Ishan Uday' scheme under UGC
Upload Domicile and Income certificates
Submit for verification by the admitted University/College

verification.notes: Verified against UGC Ishan Uday guidelines.

name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme For CAPFs And AR
description: Scholarship to encourage higher technical and professional education for the dependent wards and widows of Central Armed Police Forces & Assam Rifles personnel.
authority: Welfare and Rehabilitation Board (WARB), Ministry of Home Affairs
eligibility: Wards/Widows of deceased CAPF & AR personnel who died in harness/election duty
Wards of personnel disabled due to causes attributable to Government service
Wards of Ex-CAPF & AR personnel in receipt of Gallantry Awards
Must have secured a minimum of 60% marks in Minimum Entry Qualification (Class 12/Diploma/Graduation)
Pursuing first professional degree course recognized by statutory bodies
incomeCriteria: No specific income limit; preference is based on the category of the ward (e.g., Category A for wards of martyrs has highest priority).
categoryCriteria: Wards/Widows of CAPF and Assam Rifles personnel
benefits: ₹3,000 per month for Girls (Paid annually as ₹36,000)
₹2,500 per month for Boys (Paid annually as ₹30,000)
Covers the standard duration of the professional degree (up to 5 years)
documents: Service Certificate / Discharge Certificate / PPO of the serving/retired/deceased personnel

procedure: Register and apply via the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Select WARB Ministry of Home Affairs PMSS Scheme
Upload the required dependent/service certificates
Application is verified by the Institute and then by WARB

name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme For RPF/RPSF
description: Scholarship scheme to promote higher technical and professional education for the dependent wards of ex/serving RPF/RPSF personnel and widows of RPF/RPSF personnel.
eligibility: Wards/widows of ex-RPF/RPSF personnel
Wards of serving RPF/RPSF personnel
Must have secured at least 60% marks in the Minimum Entry Qualification (Class 12 / Diploma / Graduation)
Must be admitted to recognized professional / technical degree courses
incomeCriteria: Priority is given to wards of deceased, disabled, or ex-personnel, followed by serving personnel based on rank.
benefits: ₹3,000 per month for Female Students (Paid annually as ₹36,000)
₹2,500 per month for Male Students (Paid annually as ₹30,000)
documents: Service Certificate / PPO of RPF/RPSF personnel

procedure: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Upload required service documents of parents
Complete institutional verification

officialSources.sourceName: National Scholarship Portal - Ministry of Railways

name: Top Class Education Scheme for SC Students
description: Scheme to promote qualitative education amongst SC students by providing full financial support for pursuing studies beyond 12th class in notified institutions of excellence (like IITs, IIMs, NITs, AIIMS, etc.).
authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
educationLevel: Undergraduate and Postgraduate courses in Top Institutions
eligibility: Must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC)
Must have secured admission in a notified 'Top Class' institution (e.g., IIT, NIT, IIM, NLU)
Selection is based on the merit ranking in the entrance exam of the respective institution
incomeCriteria: Total family income from all sources must not exceed ₹8,00,000 per annum.
benefits: Full tuition fee and non-refundable charges reimbursement (up to ₹2 Lakh for private sector institutes, full for govt)
Living expenses of ₹3,000 per month
Books and stationery allowance of ₹5,000 per annum
Computer/Laptop grant of ₹45,000 (one-time)
documents: Admission Letter/Rank Card from the Top Class Institution

procedure: Admitted students apply through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
The Top Class Institution verifies the application and forwards it to the Ministry for approval and direct fund transfer

verification.notes: Verified against MSJE Top Class scheme guidelines.

name: National Fellowship and Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students
description: An umbrella scheme providing financial assistance to ST students for pursuing higher education in Top Class Institutes and for pursuing M.Phil/Ph.D. programs.
eligibility: Must belong to Scheduled Tribe (ST)
For Scholarship: Secured admission in a notified Top Class Institution
For Fellowship: Registered for regular and full-time M.Phil/Ph.D. courses in UGC recognized Universities/Institutes
incomeCriteria: For Scholarship (Top Class): Family income must not exceed ₹6,00,000. For Fellowship: No income limit.
benefits: Scholarship: Full tuition fee, living expenses @ ₹2,220/month, Books/Stationery @ ₹3,000/annum, Computer @ ₹45,000
Fellowship: ₹31,000/month (JRF) or ₹35,000/month (SRF) plus HRA and Contingency grant
documents: Admission/Registration proof for Top Class or Ph.D.

procedure: Fellowship applications are submitted via the National Tribal Fellowship portal
Top Class Scholarship applications are submitted via the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Verification is done by the respective University/Institute

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
description: Centrally sponsored scheme (now largely subsumed under PM YASASVI) to provide financial assistance to OBC students studying at pre-matriculation or secondary stage.
authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / State Govts
eligibility: Student must belong to the Other Backward Classes (OBC)
Must be studying in Class 9 or 10 in a recognized school
incomeCriteria: Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000.
benefits: Academic allowance of ₹4,000 per annum

procedure: Apply via the State Scholarship Portal or NSP (as mandated by the respective state)
Submit required caste and income proof for institutional verification

verification.notes: Verified against subsumed PM YASASVI / Pre-Matric OBC rules.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
description: Scheme to provide financial assistance to OBC students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education.
eligibility: Must belong to Other Backward Classes (OBC)
Must be pursuing recognized post-matriculation courses
incomeCriteria: Annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,50,000.
benefits: Maintenance allowance per month
Reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees
Study tour charges and thesis typing/printing charges

procedure: Apply via the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) or State specific portals (e.g., SSP Karnataka, MahaDBT)
Upload mandatory certificates
Institute verification followed by State approval for DBT

name: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship
description: Scholarship for meritorious girl students belonging to minority communities to assist them with school education.
authority: Maulana Azad Education Foundation, Ministry of Minority Affairs
eligibility: Girl students belonging to minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi)
Must be studying in Classes 9 to 12
Must have secured at least 50% marks or equivalent grade in the previous class
incomeCriteria: Annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,00,000.
benefits: ₹5,000 each for Class 9 and 10
₹6,000 each for Class 11 and 12
Assistance covers admission/tuition fees and maintenance expenses

procedure: Apply online via the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Select the Begum Hazrat Mahal scheme under Ministry of Minority Affairs
Upload the required documents and submit for school verification

name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
description: Innovation in Science Pursuit for Inspired Research (INSPIRE) Scholarship aims to attract talented youth into the study of basic sciences at the undergraduate and postgraduate levels.
educationLevel: Undergraduate and Postgraduate (B.Sc, B.S., Int. M.Sc/M.S. in Basic & Natural Sciences)
eligibility: Must be among the top 1% of successful students in Class 12th Board Examinations
Must be enrolled in courses in Basic and Natural Sciences at B.Sc, B.S., or Int. M.Sc/M.S. level
Students securing ranks in JEE (Main)/JEE (Advanced)/NEET and opting to study Basic Sciences are also eligible
incomeCriteria: No income limit.
benefits: Total value of ₹80,000 per annum
Includes a cash scholarship of ₹60,000 per annum and a summer time attachment/mentorship grant of ₹20,000 per annum
documents: Eligibility Note / Advisory Note provided by the State/Central Board
Endorsement Certificate signed by College Principal/Director

procedure: Register on the INSPIRE web portal
Fill the online application for SHE and upload the Board Eligibility Note and College Endorsement Certificate
Submit the application during the active call for applications (usually Nov-Dec)

verification.notes: Verified against DST INSPIRE SHE guidelines.

name: PM YASASVI Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme
description: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India for OBCs, EBCs and DNT Students studying in classes 9 and 10.
eligibility: Must belong to OBC, Economically Backward Class (EBC), or De-Notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Tribes (DNT)
Must be studying in Class 9 or 10 in identified top schools/government schools
incomeCriteria: Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000.
benefits: Scholarship amount of ₹4,000 per annum to support education expenses

procedure: Apply via the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Select the PM YASASVI Pre-Matric scheme
Upload required income and category certificates
School/Institute verification

verification.notes: Verified against PM YASASVI scheme structure.

name: PM YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme
description: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC, and DNT students to enable them to pursue higher education from class 11 onwards.
eligibility: Must belong to OBC, EBC, or DNT categories
Must be studying at a recognized post-matriculation institution
incomeCriteria: Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000.
benefits: Maintenance allowance per month (based on course group)
Reimbursement of tuition fees (subject to state limits)
Study tour charges and thesis printing charges

procedure: Apply via NSP or respective State Scholarship Portal
Fill out application details and upload mandatory documents
Submit for verification at the institutional and state levels

name: Financial Assistance for Education of the Wards of Beedi/Cine/IOMC/LSDM Workers (Post-Matric)
description: Scholarship to the wards of Beedi, Cine, Iron Ore, Manganese Ore & Chrome Ore Mines (IOMC), and Limestone & Dolomite Mines (LSDM) workers to pursue higher education.
educationLevel: Class 11 to PG, Medical, Engineering, Professional Degrees
eligibility: Either of the parents must be a Beedi, Cine, or Mine worker with at least six months of service
Must have passed the previous academic year
Must be pursuing regular courses of general or technical education
incomeCriteria: Monthly income of the worker's family must not exceed ₹10,000 (or ₹1,00,000 for Cine workers).
benefits: Scholarship amount ranges from ₹3,000 to ₹25,000 per annum depending on the course of study (e.g., Professional courses get highest amount)
documents: Identity Card of the worker (issued by Labour Welfare Organization)

procedure: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Apply under the Ministry of Labour & Employment scheme
Upload the Worker ID card and other academic documents
Submit for Institutional and Labour Welfare Organization verification

name: Dr. Ambedkar Post-Matric Scholarship for EBC Students
description: A centrally sponsored scheme to provide financial assistance to Economically Backward Class (EBC) students for post-matriculation higher education.
eligibility: Must belong to General Category (Other than SC/ST/OBC) falling under Economically Backward Class
Must be pursuing post-matriculation courses in recognized institutions
incomeCriteria: Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000 (Subject to state adaptations).
benefits: Maintenance allowance per month
Reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees
Reader charges for blind students

procedure: Apply via the NSP or the respective State Scholarship Portal
Upload the EBC / Income certificate
Submit for verification at the institutional and state nodal officer levels

name: National Fellowship for Scheduled Caste Students (NFSC)
description: Fellowship scheme to provide financial assistance to SC students for pursuing higher education leading to M.Phil/Ph.D. Degrees in Sciences, Humanities, and Social Sciences.
authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / UGC
eligibility: Must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC)
Must have qualified the National Eligibility Test (NET-JRF/CSIR-NET) or have been selected through UGC-specified mechanisms
Must be registered for regular and full-time M.Phil/Ph.D. course in a recognized University/Institution
incomeCriteria: No income limit.
benefits: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF): ₹31,000 per month (for 2 years)
Senior Research Fellowship (SRF): ₹35,000 per month (for remaining 3 years)
Contingency grant and Escorts/Reader assistance for Divyang scholars
House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per rules

procedure: Selection is primarily based on the merit list of UGC-NET and CSIR-NET
Selected candidates download the award letter from the UGC/NTA portal
Candidate submits the joining report through their respective university to UGC to start the fellowship disbursement via DBT

name: National Fellowship for OBC Students (NFOBC)
description: Fellowship scheme providing financial assistance to OBC students to pursue advanced studies and research leading to M.Phil/Ph.D. Degrees.
authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
eligibility: Must belong to Other Backward Classes (OBC)
Must have qualified UGC-NET or CSIR-NET
Must be registered for regular, full-time M.Phil or Ph.D. program in recognized universities
incomeCriteria: The scheme targets the unreserved among OBCs (i.e., non-creamy layer), thus implying the prevailing NCL income limit (₹8,00,000).
benefits: Junior Research Fellowship (JRF): ₹31,000 per month (for initial 2 years)
Senior Research Fellowship (SRF): ₹35,000 per month (for remaining tenure)
Contingency grant and HRA

procedure: Selection based on the UGC-NET / CSIR-NET OBC merit list
Download the NFOBC award letter from UGC portal
Submit the joining report through the university on the UGC Scholarship portal to initiate DBT

name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana (MYSY)
description: A flagship state scholarship scheme by the Government of Gujarat providing financial assistance to meritorious and needy students pursuing higher education.
educationLevel: Diploma, Undergraduate (Medical, Engineering, Arts, Commerce, Science)
eligibility: Must be a domicile of Gujarat
For Diploma: Passed Class 10 with minimum 80 PR (Percentile Rank)
For UG (Engg/Pharmacy/Science/Arts/Commerce): Passed Class 12 (Science/General) with minimum 80 PR
For Medical/Dental: Passed Class 12 with 80 PR and admitted to MBBS/BDS/Ayurveda/Homeopathy courses
Must have taken admission in recognized colleges/universities in Gujarat
incomeCriteria: Annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹6,00,000.
benefits: Tuition Fee Assistance: 50% of the tuition fee or maximum up to ₹2 Lakh for Medical, ₹50,000 for Engineering/Pharmacy, ₹10,000 for B.A/B.Com/B.Sc, and ₹25,000 for Diploma
Hostel assistance of ₹12,000 per year (for students living outside taluka limit)
Book/Equipment assistance up to ₹10,000 (one-time)
documents: Admission Letter and Tuition Fee Receipt
Hostel admission proof (if claiming hostel assistance)

procedure: Visit the official MYSY portal (https://mysy.guj.nic.in)
Register as a fresh applicant using Board details and PR score
Fill the online application, upload documents, and submit
Visit the designated Help Centre (HC) with original documents for physical document verification
Upon successful verification at the HC, the application is forwarded for DBT sanction

verification.notes: Verified against MYSY Gujarat official portal guidelines.
